source.fingerprintMethod: Unique sorted git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard paths under src, tools, patches, package.json, package-lock.json, tsconfig.json, vite.config.ts and .github; SHA-256 over each path, NUL, file bytes, NUL.

coverage: Complete unit, native Cloudflare integration and stock-Git/browser/standalone interoperability projects.
All five authenticated stock-Git tests pass on both Node drivers.
Includes current archive receipt validation, source/target coordinator SIGKILL recovery, recovered working-tree/hub checks and R2 size preflight.
Strict reporter accepts only 11 named Linux-descriptor skips on macOS; no other skips or failures.
limits: Local dirty worktree, not a clean/tagged release candidate or remotely executed expanded CI workflow.
Both Node 24 and Node 26 drivers use the same newly built executable with embedded Node 26.10.0.
Ad-hoc signature check is not publisher signing or notarization.
No deployed Cloudflare qualification, complete production operator acceptance or final supported artifact/platform matrix.
